title: DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, February 8, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, February 8, 2018 Posted by admin on February 8th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +113 points. 
Wednesday the Dow was down -19.42 (-0.08%) at 24,893.35. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.70%. 
There were 13 Dow stocks up Wednesday. 
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Boeing (BA) +2.11% and Wal-Mart (WMT) +1.93%. 
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Apple (AAPL) -2.14% and Microsoft (MSFT) -1.88%. 
Walmart (WMT) has asked vendors for more merchandise priced at $10 and up to sell online in an effort to make its online business profitable. 
Initial U.S. jobless claims fell by 9,000 to 221,000 in the seven days ended Feb 3. Economists had forecast a 235,000 reading. The more stable monthly average of claims declined by 10,000 to 224,500, the government said Thursday. That’s the lowest level since March 1973. 
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.602 per gallon.
